title: Store revenue
description: Weekly revenue and top customers from the demo schema

cells.content:
# Store revenue
Revenue from the `demo` schema. Pick the order statuses to include; every SQL cell below re-runs with the new value.

-- Weekly revenue for the selected statuses
select date_trunc('week', placed_at)::date as week,
       sum(total)::numeric(12, 2) as revenue,
       count(*) as orders
from demo.order_totals
where status::text = any(string_to_array({{statuses}}, ','))
group by 1
order by 1;

-- Top customers
select customer, count(*) as orders, sum(total)::numeric(12, 2) as revenue
from demo.order_totals
where status::text = any(string_to_array({{statuses}}, ','))
group by customer
order by revenue desc
limit 5;
